hooks.name: Type-check frontend TypeScript on save
hooks.description: Runs tsc --noEmit in frontend/ after a TypeScript file is saved. Skips if dependencies are not installed.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not (Test-Path 'frontend/node_modules')) { Write-Output 'frontend/node_modules missing; run pnpm install. Skipped.'; exit 0 }; Push-Location frontend; pnpm exec tsc --noEmit; Pop-Location; exit 0"
